capabilities: Import Zotero papers into structured literature notes
Sync Zotero highlights and comments into a note with page numbers
Promote checked candidates into permanent notes
Package a week's literature notes as a zip
Create projects and time writing sessions
disambiguation: Not an e-reader or text-to-speech tool; it manages Zotero literature notes and the course workflow around them.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux). Free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no account or payment. Downloads the PDF utility from GitHub and checks it against a built-in SHA-256 checksum; setup and upgrade instructions live in separate files (STUDENT-SETUP-GUIDE.md, UPDATING.md, UPDATE-REPORT-2.3.md).
intentEvidence: 2.x copies the import formats and other settings from the community Zotero Integration plugin
problem: Zotero reading and highlights sit apart from Obsidian notes, so literature notes have to be copied by hand and candidates turned into permanent notes one at a time.

relations.evidence: Import a paper from Zotero into a structured literature note
Requires Zotero 7 with the Better BibTeX plugin
copies the import formats and other settings from the community Zotero Integration plugin
Highlight sync and PDF import use pdfannots2json, a program by mgmeyers that reads annotations out of PDF files
A template that uses Templater is run through Templater
A Dataview query under "Permanent notes not yet used" is replaced by the plugin's list
A done date added by the Tasks plugin is ignored
Until Second Reader appears in the community directory, install it with BRAT instead

summary: Literature-note workflow plugin that imports Zotero papers, syncs highlights with page numbers, and promotes candidates into permanent notes.
